name: Atlas
tagline: Multi-agent AI platform that builds production 3D asset pipelines for games.
description: Atlas (Atlas AI Studio) orchestrates fleets of specialized AI agents that generate, texture, optimize, and engine-integrate 3D, 2D, and motion assets from natural-language descriptions and moodboards. Rather than producing isolated outputs from a single model, it assembles end-to-end production pipelines aimed at studio workflows, with exports to Unreal and Blender. The Vienna-based company targets games, CGI, and immersive worldbuilding.
insight: Backed by Final Fantasy studio Square Enix; AI Studio left closed beta for general availability in March 2026.

modelSupport.notes: Assembles and deploys combinations of AI models across a 3D production pipeline.

edge: Builds whole production pipelines via collaborating agents, not one-shot 'prompt to asset' outputs from a single model.
pros: AAA partners incl. Square Enix and Shrapnel
cons: Geared to studios over solo creators
Generative game assets raise IP/style questions

references.title: Square Enix-Backed Atlas Uses AI to Turn Text and Images Into Game Worlds
3D generative AI platform Atlas emerges from stealth with $6M
